title: Daily Life on the Mongol Steppe
hook: Your entire home could be packed up in two hours.

scenes.text: On the vast Eurasian steppe, survival meant moving constantly across hundreds of miles of open grassland.

scenes.text: You lived in a felt-covered round tent called a ger, engineered to resist sub-zero blizzard winds.
scenes.imagePrompt: Traditional round white felt ger tent standing on open rolling plains. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: Children learned to ride tough steppe ponies almost as soon as they learned to walk.
scenes.imagePrompt: Wooden horse corral with leather saddles and horsehair ropes on a grassy slope. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: Your diet was almost entirely animal-based: mutton broth, dried curd called aaruul, and fermented mare's milk.
scenes.imagePrompt: Interior hearth of a felt tent with an iron cauldron and carved wooden bowls. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: When seasonal pasture ran dry, the whole camp collapsed their homes, loaded wooden carts, and rode onward.
